items.title: Amazon Kinesis
items.description: Kinesis Data Streams vs Kinesis Data Firehose vs Kinesis Data Analytics. Shards, partition keys, sequence numbers, Enhanced Fan-Out, Lambda ESM, and when to use Kinesis vs SQS.

items.title: AWS AppSync
items.description: AWS AppSync for DVA-C02. GraphQL API service, resolvers, data sources (DynamoDB, Lambda, RDS, HTTP), real-time subscriptions, caching, authorization modes, and comparison with API Gateway.

items.title: Real-Time Updates
